thread.title: Dow Jones Poised To End Losing Streak

author: EdJenner
title: Dow Jones Poised To End Losing Streak
text:
Bulls kept a tight grip on most stock-market gains late Monday morning, while the Dow Jones industrial average looked poised to end a four-session losing streak.
X
The Nasdaq spurted ahead 1.2%. The blue-chip Dow Jones and the large-cap S&P 500 surged 1.1% and 1%, respectively. Small caps kept pace as the Russell 2000 added 1.1%.
Volume rose on both major exchanges. The increase in volume, though, came vs. Friday’s holiday-dampened trade. The stock market closed three hours earlier than usual Friday.
In the Dow Jones, almost half of the 30 components advanced 2% or more. The day’s blue-chip leaders included American Express ( AXP ), up 3%; Goldman Sachs ( GS ), up 2.5%; IBM ( IBM ), up 2%; and JPMorgan Chase ( CSCO ), up 2.5%.
Financials got a lift as the 10-year Treasury yield rose. It was recently trading around 3.07%, up 3 basis points.
Among IBD’s 197 industry groups, one of every six were up 2% or more. Advancers included groups in the retail, bank and oil sectors. Dairy led the downside.
Some quality names struggled. Leaderboard stock Ulta Beauty ( ULTA ) popped 1.9% in the first two minutes of trade and then gave back virtually all of it. Apple ( AAPL ) added 1.5% in the first half-hour of trade and then trimmed half the gain. Continental Resources ( CLR ) climbed 3.3% in the first 10 minutes of trade and then returned all but 1.4%.
But Amazon.com ( AMZN ) built on early gains and was up 3.5% in late morning action. Few Breakouts
Breakouts were scarce Monday. Biotech Forty Seven ( FTSV ), a June initial public offering , cleared a 16.10 buy point. Alcoholic beverage maker Diageo ( DEO ) triggered a 144.09 buy point in a double-bottom pattern. Badger Meter ( BMI ) gapped up past a 53.71 buy point.
